abertura: The game gets more fun the less it matters, and the less it matters the better you perform, because the game rewards the one who seeks no reward but the game itself.
transcricao: The game gets more fun the less it matters, and the less it matters the better you perform, because the game rewards the one who seeks no reward but the game itself. If you're doing something primarily because you want to win or you want money, then your brain is wired to seek that thing and that thing alone. Inevitably the day will come where you're not winning or you're not making as much money, and when it does, you're going to begin to hate the task that's required to get it. But the person who loves the game for the sake of the game can never be disappointed, because they're not dependent on an outcome. The game is the one constant. So if you let go and enjoy the game for what it is, you will have a much more fun life.
